chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Basir: that he asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Does a man increase in prayer during Ramadan? He said, 'Yes, indeed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had increased in prayer during Ramadan.'

key_terms.رَمَضَانَ: Ramadan (the month of fasting and increased worship)
key_terms.زَادَ: Increased (referring to the quantity or duration of prayer)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to increase voluntary prayers during Ramadan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* confirms the permissibility of increasing voluntary prayers (nafl) in Ramadan, citing the Prophet’s practice as the primary precedent. In Shia jurisprudence, this supports the specific emphasis on *Tarawih* and extended night prayers during the month, distinguishing Ramadan's spiritual volume from other months. The narration underscores the continuity of prophetic tradition (Sunnah) in enhancing devotional intensity during the holy month.
